chapters.title: Executive Truth
chapters.html:
This book is the radical-honesty catalog of all 46 breakthrough entries mined from Brandon's 2,463,445-word corpus, workspace projects, and the 52-app Feature Map — dated 2026-11-05.

Read the tiers in order. Tier 1 is what you can touch today. Tier 2 is what to build next. Tier 3 is math with exact numbers (and clear labels for what is proven vs open). Tier 4 is overlooked gems. Tier 0 is listed so nobody wastes a week chasing fluff.

Strongest real cluster: Pulse Forge (validated PPG) + Bot Stage Training Room/UBTF + Main Base + phone-first app empire (WRL / Campus / MyCrew / Concept Fusion) + continuity stack (Ascent Ledger, Thread Lattice, Scarlight, ZipJsonSplitter).

Strongest unfinished-but-real cluster: Agent Angel bounded wearable, ARA Garage Stage-1 Michelson kill-test, Matrix Table Runner as software, Fact-Tree editor, Invisible Guitar + breathe-lock, bio-gating on Pulse Forge.

T1-001: Pulse Forge — Camera PPG Signal Pipeline

Status: BUILT + VALIDATED in /workspace/pulse-forge (ppg_*.dart ~8.5k lines; VALIDATION_REPORT.md)

Domain: signal_processing / Android wellness

Also called: Pulse Forge, Sovereign Reactor bio-tone, PPG

Phone-camera fingertip photoplethysmography (PPG) at ~30 Hz with torch on: accelerometer motion rejection, zero-phase Butterworth band-pass, adaptive peak/IBI detection, signal-quality gate that REFUSES to print BPM on bad signal, Insights export. Validated offline on PhysioNet BIDMC + Wrist-PPG datasets — held-out HR MAPE 0.3%. Wellness tool, not a medical device. Disguise words like 'Sovereign Reactor / bio-tone' wrap this real DSP stack.

Next step: Ship bio-gating consumers on top of live SQI/HRV bands (Tier 2).

Tier 3 — Python-Verified Math Findings (8)

T3-001: Hi = √3/5 ≈ 0.34641016 (algebraic identity; NOT Collatz Lyapunov)

Status: VERIFIED identity; REJECTED as Collatz proof

Domain: number theory / proof attempt

Also called: 0.3464 Harmonic Invariant, Hi, Mirror Gate companion

Definition Hi=√3/5 is an exact algebraic identity (computed 0.3464101615…). A fixed constant cannot itself be a strictly decreasing Lyapunov function of the Collatz state. Paper's Q.E.D. that Collatz is proven via Hi is NOT supported.

Next step: Keep Hi as a teaching constant / Visual Math demo; remove Q.E.D. language.

T3-002: Mirror Gate Ω = 202/121 ≈ 1.66942

Status: VERIFIED rational; role OPEN

Domain: number theory

Also called: Mirror Gate, Ω, 202/121

Exact rational 202/121. Role as Collatz bifurcation threshold is unverified. 202 appears often in Brandon's palindromic-collapse explorations.

Next step: If keeping as heuristic, define Ω operationally on trajectories and test large-n statistics.

T3-003: ~0.58 bits/cycle entropy deficit ↔ log2(3)−1 ≈ 0.58496

Status: PARTIAL MATCH to log2(3)-1; NOT a completed proof

Domain: Collatz heuristics

Also called: entropy deficit ~0.58, Law Zero Point Root

Closest standard quantity to the claimed ~0.58 is log2(3)−1 ≈ 0.58496 — bit-growth of a pure odd step 3n+1 before divisions. The STANDARD Syracuse heuristic contraction is log2(3/4) ≈ −0.415 bits per odd-step cycle (assuming ~2 trailing factors of 2). Recognizing the expansion term is real Collatz folklore; it does NOT prove all n→1.

Next step: Write the exact formula Brandon intends for 'bits/cycle' and re-test.

T3-004: ℓ_H ≈ 87.953 μm = (ħc/ρ_Λ)^{1/4} cosmological length

Status: NUMERICAL MATCH to cosmology construction

Domain: cosmology phenomenology

Also called: ℓ_H, ell_H, Yukawa harmonic length, dark-energy length

Using energy density ρ_Λ = ΩΛ·3H0²c²/(8πG) with H0≈67.4 km/s/Mpc and ΩΛ≈0.6889, (ħc/ρ_Λ)^{1/4} ≈ 87.9531149 μm — matches Brandon's 87.953 μm within ~0.001%. This validates the NUMBER as the standard dark-energy length scale. It does NOT confirm inertial-mass modulation or propulsion.

Next step: Keep ℓ_H as fiducial; test Yukawa residual experimentally at Stage 1.

T3-005: Collatz 4-2-1 cycle + small-seed reachability (classical)

Status: CONFIRMED classical facts; small-n tests pass

Domain: number theory

Also called: 4-2-1 singularity, Collatz trajectories

The 4→2→1 loop is the classical terminal cycle. All 9 probe seeds and 80 π-digit chunk seeds tested here reached 1 (expected for small n). This is consistent with known verification, not a new proof.

Next step: Use as Visual Math demo with honest 'not a proof' badge.

Status: Arithmetic TRUE; physical claims unsupported

Domain: number patterns / design motif

Also called: 3-6-9, Recursive 369 Feedback Loop, digital root

41×9=369 is exact. Digital-root cycles are standard. Useful as a memorable design motif for feedback UX and guitar tunings — not a physical law.

Next step: Keep as Visual Math + Tuning Detective motif with honest labeling.

Status: OPEN — insufficient source equations in indexed <100MB corpus

Domain: materials exploratory

Also called: F/0 ratio 0.215, Fmmm phase, nickelate blueprints

Named in Ara recovery PDF only in indexed corpus; no derivation or measurement found this pass.

Next step: Locate nickelate blueprint docs (possibly inside >100MB archives) before claiming.

Standard Yukawa parametrization with α_H=1/3. Numerical phase prediction depends on stated fiducials. Good science (null criterion given) but zero experimental confirmation yet.
